skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the clip, add a text overlay, and export via API — and get edited MP4...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of editor-api skill for automated, programmatic video editing via API.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB.
- Provides seamless session and authentication handling, including free starter tokens for new users.
- Enables quick actions: trim, overlay text, edit tracks, and export to MP4 in under a minute.
- Built-in chat command recognition for exports, credits, state, and uploads.
- Cloud GPU rendering with status updates and direct download links for completed videos.
